correctness.rationale: The halfspace representation follows exactly from barycentric weighted Minkowski sums of coordinate boxes. Orthogonal projection gives r<=rho with unique projected equality center y_j=rho. At this center each lower x_i>=rho and upper facet normalized by H_i gives x_i<=rho(B_i-H_i), so criterion and all centers are necessary/sufficient; contact pattern from tight slacks. For positive integer matrix C(A) contains Delta_d x [0,1]^m and rho<1/2, ensuring strict interval widths. For sparse rows, (B-1)^2-H^2=2[alpha sqrt(d)(beta-1)+beta(alpha-1)]>=0 with equality iff alpha=beta=1. Independent scipy LP solver checked 216 independently formulated nonnegative small matrices, plus radical sparse cases.
